output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the mintedAmount is large, the balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; totalSupply += mintedAmount; can cause a overflow, and the minted tokens will be owned by anyone.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the _value is large, the balanceOf[_to] += _value; can cause a overflow, and the unexpected tokens will be transferred to the target.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the _value is large, the balanceOf[_to] += _value; can cause a overflow, and the unexpected tokens will be transferred to the target.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount is large, the balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount; can cause a overflow, and the unexpected tokens will be transferred to the target.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount is large, the if (!msg.sender.send(amount * sellPrice)) { throw; } can cause a overflow, and the unexpected tokens will be transferred to the target.
